whats is this project about
This project is **SHG**, an interactive and automation-focused CLI for **Capacitor Android development**. It helps developers: - Set up Capacitor Android projects - Run live-reload development over USB or Wi‑Fi - Build APKs/AABs - Deploy and manage Android devices - View Logcat logs - Manage plugins, assets, versions, and configuration - Diagnose Android/Java/SDK issues It also includes a **React + Vite documentation website** in `web/`.
